g.text: Categories from the chromatin state of section 10_01: K27ac only (body state Active), Bivalent (bivalent promoter or Mixed body), K27me3 only (Polycomb body, promoter not bivalent), Neither | Kruskal-Wallis chi-squared = 211.5, df = 3, p = 1.4e-45
